description: Renovate config for minimal-java. Extends the recommended preset; see https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/ for tuning options (auto-merge policies, schedules, grouping rules). See docs/renovate.md for how this repo's setup fits together.

packageRules.description: Major bumps land on the Dependency Dashboard as a checkbox instead of opening a PR automatically. Tick the box, run Renovate, and it opens the PR — keeps the review queue free of breaking-change PRs you didn't ask for.

Base images use ${ARG}-composed tags (eclipse-temurin:${JAVA_VERSION}-jre, ubuntu:${UBUNTU_VERSION}). Renovate's Docker manager can DETECT these but cannot rewrite the literal tag in place, so non-major PRs just fail to create and clutter the dashboard. Disable non-major updates for them — the Dockerfile keeps its clean major tags (25, 26.04), and a new MAJOR still surfaces on the dashboard so you can bump the ARG by hand. (chisel is unaffected: it's the custom 'regex' manager, which edits its ARG line directly.)

customManagers.description: Track the chisel release pinned in the Dockerfile's CHISEL_VERSION ARG. chisel is fetched from a GitHub release URL (not referenced as an image tag), so the Docker manager can't see it — the `# renovate:` annotation above the ARG plus this regex manager edit that ARG line directly. Unlike the ubuntu/temurin base images (whose ${ARG}-composed tags the Docker manager can detect but not rewrite), chisel updates apply cleanly because the version IS the whole ARG value.
